english:
My name is Reenu. I come from a St. Anne’s parish near Angamaly. I first heard about Kreupasanam when I witnessed the healing of a nine-month-old child’s illness in Youtube.
After that, one of my friends named Jincy,
who works in Dubai, used to upload posts on Kreupasanam’s Facebook pages. After seeing that, I asked her and understood more about what Kreupasanam is.
After that, I started offering candle prayers at Kreupasanam,
attending retreats, and participating in apparition prayers and all that. After that, in 2020,
I took the online covenant for the first time. After that also, I used to do candle prayers and other prayers regularly.
In April 2023, I took the pilgrimage covenant. Now what I want to share is about a miraculous escape that happened to me two weeks ago.
On January 4, 2026, at night around 12 o’clock,
the car we were travelling in collided with a tourist bus near Angamaly, at a place called Vengoor,
and the car was completely damaged. There were six of us in the car — myself, my husband,
my three children, and my husband’s mother. Since it was night, everyone was in a light sleep.
I was awake till 11:51. After that, my husband, unusually, told me to recline my seat,
close your eyes, and lie down for a while. At first, I stayed sitting like that, but after some time,
I reclined my seat and closed my eyes. I could hear the sound of the indicator. After that, I don’t know what suddenly happened to me.
I believe the Mother put me into a deep sleep. Then I woke up hearing a terrifying explosion sound.
When I looked, the bus had come straight and crashed into the front of us.
I saw it rushing and hitting us. At that moment, I felt as if something like a mountain came and stood in front of us.
I always used to tell my husband to put the child lock on whenever we got into the car. Suddenly, a thought came into my mind,
but that day I forgot to say it. I could only cry out, “My Mother.” I screamed loudly, crying and pleading, calling “My Mother.”
At that moment, the Mother came down there. None of us had even a single scratch.
Looking at the condition of the vehicle lying there, no one who stood there could believe,
how we managed to come out of it without even a scratch or a single drop of blood.
Then all of us went to LF Hospital. I had a slight discomfort in my chest. After reaching there,
they took a CT scan and all that. I noticed everyone looking at me with great astonishment.
I saw people standing there and talking, looking at this. Seeing that, I felt something strange, something unsettling within me. After that,
when they took an X-ray of my daughter, they said there was a fracture in the spine. At that moment,
lying on that bed, I was holding my covenant medal, which I always keep in my hand and always wear around my neck.
Holding that rosary, I cried and pleaded to the Mother, “Let nothing happen, Mother.” For confirmation, they took the child for a CT scan.
When the CT scan result came, the fracture that was seen in the X-ray was not there.
Thus, the Mother blessed us. After that, the next day, many people came to our house. Many people came to see us. At that time, everyone was looking at me with great amazement.
Then I wondered what this was all about. Then, something inside me said, “If you have photos of the car, look at them.”
So I asked for the photos from the people who had taken them and collected them. It was only after looking at them that I realized this.
It was not for nothing that everyone was looking at me with astonishment. The side on which I was sitting was the one that was completely destroyed.
The door on my side was gone. I don’t know how I remained there without even a movement or injury. I don’t know. My Mother and Jesus came and held it there.
None of our bodies had even a single drop of blood. My entire body was intact. Not even a single drop of blood had fallen. On my husband’s shirt collar,
we saw two drops of blood splashed. My husband searched to find where that blood came from, but there was blood on no one.
Even today, I firmly believe this. When I came here on November 5th to renew my covenant, I wrote six intentions and sat there for some time. I received token number 512.
Five minutes before they called 512, at that last moment, I wrote beneath it,
asking that the protection of Your Divine Son’s Precious Blood and the protection of the Blessed Mother’s blue mantle be assured to me and my family.
I believe today that it was that assurance the Mother gave us there.
I believe today that the blood seen on that shirt was the Precious Blood of Jesus.
Even today, we do not know where it came from. No one was injured. There wasn’t even a scratch.
No one had any kind of problem or injury. After that, when I sat and looked at these photos,
I saw what appeared to be an image of the Blessed Mother becoming visible in them. There was no sticker of the Mother in our car like that, but still,
an image of the Blessed Mother appeared in it. There was even a face visible. Seeing this helped increase the faith of many people. Through this, the Mother blessed us abundantly.
This is that photo. I do not know how clear it is for how many people. There is also another photo like this, with a similar face.
I showed it here to the Sister. Likewise, the next thing is, the first time I came here to Kreupasanam, no one at home knew about it.
After that, when my daughter was one and a half years old, she had a condition where her teeth were crumbling.
Without giving anesthesia, I saw them doing a root canal while holding her on my lap, on her front four teeth.
At that time, I could not bear it. That day, I came and stood at the steps of Kreupasanam with her and prayed,
“My Mother, the doctor has said this will spread to all the teeth and the infection had already reached the nose. Let there be no chance for even a single tooth to crumble.”
Just like that, from the moment I came, it stopped there, as if a switch had been turned off. Now she is eight years old,
and till today, not even one tooth has needed filling or treatment. I believe this is a great blessing of the Blessed Mother.
Likewise, my other two children are twins. All three of them have only a one-year gap.
At that time, it was not possible for me to go to work. I used to always pray
during the covenant that the Mother should bless me with a job that I could do while taking care of my children. As part of that,
I received a job as a school teacher, and the job became settled. Then, likewise, due to the use of steroids, for about two years,
I had severe itching and allergy in my private areas, which did not heal despite doctors giving many medicines.
The Blessed Mother removed it. Without even my realizing it, it was taken away. Likewise, while I was in the online covenant,
in front of my house, I was removing soil from a bag to plant something.
When all the soil was removed and only one last handful remained, as I bent down to pick it up,
I felt something like a pressure striking my head. I then used one leg to step on that soil.
Inside it, I saw something coiled up, like the strap of an old bag.
I stepped on it once with my foot, and then stepped again. On the second step, I saw it start to slither and move.
It was a snake belonging to the shankhuvarayan species, which is considered the most venomous among the four venomous snakes found in our region.
It did not touch me at all. At that time, my daughter was three and a half years old.
That child said, “Looking at the image of the Mother, didn’t you see the Mother crushing a snake under her feet?
That is exactly how it felt to me when I saw my mother standing there.” She said that is what she felt. All this is the Mother’s protection.
If I had scooped the soil with my hand, this would not have happened. It was my Mother who made me feel to act that way.
Likewise, the Mother has granted me many, many blessings, both small and great. Similarly, through missionary activities and works of charity,
I have been able to give contributions to provide food for one person for a day at an orphanage. After giving the newsletters,
I usually try to give only to people I know. But the last time I came, I was able to reach many people I did not know,
especially many non-Catholics. Not even a single one was left. Everything was fully distributed. Truly, nothing remained.
Likewise, I help those who need prayer support. I also deliver covenant articles to those who are sick.
One of my friends, named Pavitha, had a serious difficulty. I brought covenant articles to her house,
and she came here and took the covenant. As part of that, she received healing. She herself will come here and gives testimony about it.
Likewise, my sister-in-law has already come here and given testimony. Thus, through me, many people have been able to hear about Kreupasanam and to come here and take the covenant.
Earlier, I used to sit and read the Bible but not for half an hour.
Now, through the covenant, I have been given that grace properly. Likewise, I did not use to teach the Word to my children like that before,
but now, whenever we go out and whenever they go to school, I send them out after making them recite the Word.
Even on the day of the accident, I made them recite Psalm 17, which I always make them recite: “Guard us like the apple of Your eye; hide us under the shadow of Your wings.”
It was after proclaiming this Word that we left that day. In the same way, Jesus and the Mother embraced and protected us.
For granting me the grace to come and stand at this altar and give testimony as a witness to the apparition, I offer a thousand thanks to Jesus and the Mother.
Psalm 91:1–12 — “You have taken refuge in the Lord; you have made the Most High your dwelling place.
No evil shall befall you, no calamity shall come near your tent. For He will command His angels concerning you,
to guard you in all your ways. They will bear you up on their hands, so that your foot may not strike against a stone.” This sister named Reenu,
together with her children, joyfully bears witness to the great experiences of God she received through the covenant life of the Blessed Mother.
Dearly beloved, the covenant is a divine plan that always surrounds us and keeps us safe in times of danger and helps us experience divine protection.
Because each person who lives in the covenant begins every day by entrusting themselves to divine protection,
even in unexpected and sudden life crises, we are helped to be covered under the Mother’s blue mantle,
and to have our burdens lightened under the special protection of Jesus, allowing us to experience divine protection in a miraculous way,
in a manner that astonishes even ourselves. That is why the daughter says that it was only after seeing the photograph of the car and its condition,
that she understood that although the area where the door itself was completely shattered and the accident had severely affected the side on which she was sitting,
the Blessed Mother protected her there without any harm at all.
The family joyfully gives thanks for that great protection granted by the Mother.
Along with that, the daughter also testified that during times of illness that caused great suffering, conditions that did not heal through medicines were completely healed and restored to health
through the use of the Blessed Mother’s covenant articles. She also recalls with gratitude that even after stepping twice
with her foot on a highly venomous snake of the shankhuvarayan species, she was protected without any harm.
When life leads us into unexpected hardships, the Blessed Mother remains with us as our guardian and protector — guarding our lives,
lightening our sufferings, granting protection and help to each member of our family through various life challenges.
She continues to pour the blessings of Jesus into our lives and continually protects all those who begin each day by praying and anointing themselves in the Mother’s covenant oil.
Dearly beloved, each of the covenant articles is a sign of the profession of faith.
Whether we use covenant salt, covenant oil, offer a prayer of surrender to the Mother with desire,
go on a journey, to studies, or to work, or move forward in life holding the covenant medal in our hands, we are entrusting ourselves to divine protection.
Such acts of entrustment to divine protection always help us in times of danger and lead us to peace in times of sorrow.
It also fills us with hope in times of suffering. Remembering the joy of this and the blessings that God granted through the Blessed Mother, this family recalls and proclaims it here at this altar.
Giving thanks to the Blessed Mother and to Jesus for the protection received by this family, for guarding and caring for everyone,
and for resolving other matters of life, let us offer this testimony with applause.
